text:
Emma (CSM): Heads up — Acme Health renewal is due in 6 weeks and their token burn spiked after prod go-live. Need a quick runway + commit forecast for the QBR next Tue. Can finance + revops join to align on ask?

Raj (CSM): Onboarding is ~90% — connectors for billing + SSO still pending (eng backlog). Their workspace flipped from staging to prod last week which explains the spike. Current monthly token usage: ~1.2B, expected baseline 1.0B.

Jules (Finance): Copy. I pulled the last 30d and projected 3 scenarios. Quick numbers:
- conservative: 1.05B/mo -> $11.6k/mo
- likely: 1.3B/mo -> $14.4k/mo
- aggressive: 1.6B/mo -> $17.8k/mo
We should show commit tiers that map to those bands.

Kai (RevOps): @Jules can you drop the per-token rate assumptions for the QBR slide? I assume we're using the current hosted plan rates + a 5% discount for multi-month commit. Also need to flag renewal risk if they don't finish SSO — security review is blocking higher commit.

Jules (Finance): Sure. Using hosted rates: $0.011/token for first 1B, $0.009 thereafter, then applying 5% commit discount in the deck. I'll add a small table.

Raj (CSM): Customer sentiment is OK but they asked for clearer budget guardrails. Can we propose a 3-month ramp commit (phased) instead of upfront annual? That reduces their perceived risk and still gives us predictability.

Emma (CSM): Good idea. ops-bot, can you attach the recent usage chart and the alert history for the last 45 days?

ops-bot: Attached: usage_chart_45d.png, alerts_45d.csv

Jules (Finance): I exported a quick forecast snippet for the deck:
```
scenario, est_tokens, est_monthly_cost
conservative,1050000000,11600
likely,1300000000,14400
aggressive,1600000000,17800
```
I'll convert to USD with notes about exchange/region.

Kai (RevOps): For the QBR slides let's include 1) current burn + root cause (staging->prod switch), 2) 3 forecast bands + recommended phased commit (3/6/12 months), 3) enablement ask (SSO + billing connector ETA), 4) an automated budget alert suggestion (thresholds at +10% and +25%).

Emma (CSM): Perfect. Action items: @Raj confirm connector ETAs by EOD tomorrow; @Jules prepare slide + per-token assumptions; @Kai draft the phased commit proposal and alert thresholds. I'll schedule 30m prep with you all today at 4pm. Any objections? :thumbsup:

Raj (CSM): ack, will confirm ETAs.

Jules (Finance): ack, will have slides ready for 4pm prep.

Kai (RevOps): ack. Will draft commit options and the alert rule config snippet.

Emma (CSM): Thanks — see you at 4. I'll bring the customer notes and recent feedback highlights for QBR. :calendar:
